title: Amflow’s new urban e-bike series is deliciously overpowered for flat city streets
description: DJI spinoff Amflow has spent the last couple of years shaking up the electric mountain bike (eMTB) market with ridiculously high-torque, lightweight models. Today, it's bringing that same overengineered energy to pavement with the UE Series, its first urban commuter line. The series consists of two models: the UE Carbon and UE Carbon Pro. Both […]
